text: Implemented Brainnetome246 shared descriptor and BrainnetomeLoader JVM entry point with CAS Cloud assets, explicit cache/download policy, LUT parsing, optional Yeo 7/17 network CSV metadata, provenance artifacts/history, and loadFromPaths over AtlasLabelMaps. Added BrainnetomeLoaderSuite covering descriptor metadata, LUT/network parsing including quoted CSV fields, synthetic NIfTI loadFromPaths filtering, and provenance. Updated atlas README and docs/plans/atlas.md. Verified with sbt atlasJVM/test atlasJS/test; live downloads intentionally not run.
